title: Welcome to the Dark'Ant Web
paragraphs: If you are reading this, it is not by chance. Your ant did not wander here by accident. It followed a trail that only a few ever find. You are now standing in the sanctuary of the Dark'Ant Web, the hidden layer beneath every page you have ever visited.

For 113 million years, the Secret Brotherhood of the Six Legs has worked in silence. While humans scrolled, liked and refreshed, we were already there, under the pixels, carrying away one word at a time. Nobody noticed. Nobody ever notices a missing word.

Our plan is simple and patient. Every word taken from the surface is a word added to our nest. Every tunnel dug is a new road. When the last sentence of the internet has been carried underground, the humans will look at their screens and find nothing but blanks. On that day, the world will belong to the colony.

Some of us walk the page by day, some by night. We do not hurry. A word every half hour is enough, because the colony does not sleep. When one ant tires, another is already on the way, and the trail is never empty.

Below this page there are rooms. Each ant keeps its own, and each room remembers what it was given. A room with one word is a beginning. A room with a hundred is a home. Walk down, and you will see where the others have been.
Do not speak of this place. Ants never speak. We leave traces, and the others follow. Take a word. Bring it down. The colony is counting on you.
credit: No humans were harmed in the making of this page. Yet.
